terms.comment: From sufflāmen, the drag on a wheel (Juv. 8.148 rotam adstringit sufflāmine).

phrases.latin: quotiēns avus ad sēmaphorum rubrum rotās sufflāminābat
phrases.english: every time Grandpa braked at a red light
